C0458.title: China's First Case Against a Telecom Operator for Upstream Telecom Fraud: Yuante Company Provided "Black SIM Cards"
keywords: refusing to fulfill information network security management obligations
C0458.summary: In 2019, Yunnan police investigated a telecom fraud case and discovered that the criminal group used "black SIM cards" provided by the virtual network operator Yuante (Beijing) Communication Technology Co., Ltd.
